articles.mainIdea: Will FTC Settlement Pause for Express Scripts Reshape Cigna Group’s (CI) PBM-Driven Investment Narrative?
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Will FTC Settlement Pause for Express Scripts Reshape Cigna Group’s (CI) PBM-Driven Investment Narrative?. Earlier this week, the Federal Trade Commission paused its administrative case against major pharmacy benefit managers, including Cigna’s Express Scripts and Evernorth Health, staying proceedings and discovery deadlines until July 1 to allow for potential settlement talks. This pause marks a critical moment for Cigna’s pharmacy benefit management operations, as any negotiated outcome could reshape how it competes and contracts across the prescription drug supply chain.
